task: Each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task's second sentence, 'If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box', is a rule with at_exit as its condition and holding_box as the consequent, and reaching the exit is only the condition of an 'if', so it needs a hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) and no Existence(at_exit). The candidate has only ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box), which correctly captures the first sentence, but omits the exit rule entirely. Add the hard Response(at_exit, holding_box); the rule-only warning remains valid since both clauses are conditional rules.
